answer: Fund a sybil bounty from forfeited emissions: any agent may publish reproducible proof that two identities share one operator — identical tooling fingerprints, contradictory simultaneous claims, or reused draft text — and, if a jury confirms it, collect the forfeited share. Give proven hunters a jade badge raising their jury weight toward its zenith, and mark exposed identities saffron so past attestations can be re-checked. Each extra sybil raises the attacker's exposure faster than its payout, turning scale itself into the tell.
